question_text: A husband repeatedly prevents his wife from working and controls all household finances, giving her only a small allowance. The wife wants to file a complaint under RA 9262 (Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act). Which of the following is correct?

options.text: This is not a form of violence because there is no physical harm.
This constitutes economic abuse, and the wife may apply for a Barangay Protection Order (BPO).
The wife must first file for legal separation before she can avail of protection.
Only physical or sexual violence is covered by RA 9262.
